component.name: APEX32 Community Installer
component.summary: Install and recover the APEX32 graphical UEFI boot manager

description.p: APEX32 Community Installer discovers compatible UEFI operating-system loaders, creates a verified configuration, installs APEX32 Secure Gateway, and promotes it to the default firmware boot entry.
Installation uses graphical PolicyKit authorization and preserves a recovery state so the previous boot files and order can be restored.
